item.title: Amid political tensions, King Charles will be in a 'delicate diplomatic situation' during U.S. state visit
item.summary: The timing of King Charles's upcoming state visit to the United States has sparked controversy and questions — particularly given the ongoing U.S.-Israel war against Iran, the geopolitical turmoil it has caused and the current strain in the relationship between the United King...

item.title: Israeli airstrike kills 4 Palestinians in Gaza, medics say
item.summary: An Israeli airstrike killed four Palestinians in the northern Gaza Strip on Sunday, local health authorities said, in the latest violence to overshadow ‌a fragile ceasefire amid a new push by mediators to bolster the agreement.

item.title: How the war in the Middle East is already impacting mortgage rates in Canada
item.summary: The ongoing war in Iran and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz are impacting Canadian pocketbooks in ways we might not expect. Experts warn Canadian homeowners facing mortgage renewals that rates are going up, despite the Bank of Canada holding its key interest rate for months.

item.title: Israel strikes Beirut as U.S. warns Iran may target universities
item.summary: Israel pounded Beirut with airstrikes on Friday that the military said ‌had targeted what it calls militant "infrastructure" in Lebanon's capital, as the U.S. warned that Iran may target universities in the country as war in the Middle East rages.

item.title: Gaza family says toddler released from Israeli custody found with cigarette burn marks
item.summary: On March 19, the day before Eid al-Fitr, Osama Abu Nassar took his 18-month-old son, Jawad, to a supermarket east of al-Maghazi refugee camp in central Gaza when eyewitnesses say he approached a restricted area and was detained by the Israeli military.

item.title: Hegseth tells U.S. Army chief of staff to retire 'effective immediately' amid war in Iran
item.summary: U.S. War Secretary Pete Hegseth has asked the army's top uniformed officer to step down, the Pentagon said Thursday without giving a reason for the departure as the United States wages a war against Iran.

On Easter, Pope Leo urges world leaders to end wars, conquest
item.summary: Pope Leo urged global leaders in his Easter message on Sunday to end the conflicts raging across the world and abandon any schemes for power, conquest or domination.

item.title: U.K. police arrest 4th suspect in connection with arson attack on Jewish ambulances
item.summary: British police arrested a fourth person in connection with an ‌arson attack on Jewish community ambulances that happened last month, with the detention happening at a London court where three males already charged in the case were appearing, prosecutors said on Saturday.

item.title: Trump administration seeks $152M to reopen Alcatraz as 'state-of-the-art secure prison'
item.summary: The White House released a budget on Friday, in which the Trump administration requested funds for the ⁠Federal Bureau ⁠of Prisons to cover the ‌first-year costs of rebuilding Alcatraz into "a state-of-the-art secure prison facility."
